input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No MFN obligation runs against Customer anywhere in the agreement. Section 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and the pricing provisions contain nothing that operates as an MFN against us: § 7.1 simply fixes Fees at Order Form levels and bars undisclosed charges, and § 8.3 caps renewal uplifts at the lesser of CPI and 3% (both benefit Customer). Searches for MFN, "no less favourable", price-matching and third-party-comparison language returned nothing. This meets the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer), so no redline is proposed.
